# Marimo Studio 0.4.1

Marimo Studio 0.4.1 supports Marimo 0.25.2 and improves view previews, provider builds, and CLI feedback.

- A notebook shows the first view's preview when it opens. Static exports opened from disk explain when a local server is needed for live Studio resources.
- Deno-backed view rebuilds reuse cached dependencies during offline runs. Analyzer errors include source locations, and failed provider builds name a recovery step.
- CLI commands report workspace, target, and publication errors with the affected path and next action.
- Guides and examples match the current provider, notebook, and CLI behavior.

Marimo Studio 0.4.1 supports Python 3.10 through 3.14 and [Marimo](https://marimo.io/) 0.25.2. It requires [marimo-export](https://github.com/marimo-team/marimo-export) 0.2.2 or newer. The `deno` extra provides [Deno](https://docs.deno.com/) 2.9.5 or newer for [React](https://react.dev/), [Reveal.js](https://revealjs.com/), [Svelte](https://svelte.dev/), and [Observable Notebook Kit](https://observablehq.com/notebook-kit/kit) authoring. The `typst` extra provides the [Typst](https://typst.app/) compiler 0.15 or newer. The Quarto provider needs [Quarto](https://quarto.org/) 1.9.38 or newer on `PATH`, and the LaTeX provider needs [Tectonic](https://tectonic-typesetting.github.io/) 0.15 or newer on `PATH` or in the notebook's pixi script environment. pixi environments need [pixi](https://pixi.prefix.dev/) 0.80 or newer. The `lens` extra requires [marimo-lens](https://github.com/marimo-team/marimo-lens) 0.2.3 or newer, and Lens 0.2.4 records the page or time span of a selected region.

[All changes since 0.4.0](https://github.com/marimo-team/marimo-studio/compare/v0.4.0...v0.4.1)
